messages:
ops-broadcast-bot: Incident notice — Dedicated autoscaler cooldown loop causing delayed scale-ups for some Dedicated pools. Potential customer impact: elevated 429s and increased queueing for bursty sustained workloads. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/den-scalercool-1746 :rotating_light:
ben (oncall): Seeing repeated scale decisions reversed by cooldown timer. Autoscaler sees alloc request -> starts pod provisioning -> cooldown triggers and cancels scale before nodes are fully ready. Stack traces in logs show repeated 'cooldown override' in the last 12m.
nina (infra): Root cause hypothesis: a mis-evaluated metric (combined_cpu_rate) crossed threshold briefly triggering scale-down gating that then prevents subsequent scale-up due to cooldown overlap. I pushed a temporary patch to ignore scale-down decisions while an in-progress scale-up exists.
alex (sre): Patch applied to canary pools (dedicated-pool-canary-3). Observed one successful scale-up after the change, queue length dropped ~70% for that pool. Rolling to other low-risk pools now.
maria (cs): Which customers are affected and what's the impact window? We have 2 Premier customers reporting intermittent 429s for high-concurrency endpoints. I'll draft CS note.
product-ops: Please include the mitigation steps and ETA for full rollout. Also let us know if fallback to hosted capacity will be recommended for impacted customers.
ben (oncall): Mitigation steps: 1) apply "ignore-scale-down-during-up" patch to all Dedicated pools (in progress) 2) temporarily raise max_unallocated_timeout to give nodes more time to join 3) manual warm-up for active pools with pending requests. ETA for global rollout ~25min.
nina (infra): Rolling patch to all regions now. S3 of logs: `awslogs tail /redwood/autoscaler --start="5m" | grep cooldown` shows reduced cancellations in canary after patch.
alex (sre): Workaround for urgently affected customers: we can pin them to burstable hosted capacity for the next 1–2 hours. Recommend offering automatic burst to remove customer-facing errors immediately.
maria (cs): Noted. I'll message affected accounts with ETA and option for hosted burst.
ops-broadcast-bot: Status update saved to thread and status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/den-scalercool-1746 — Current status: partial mitigation in progress, customer impact reduced, monitoring.
ben (oncall): Postmortem owners: infra (nina), autoscaler engineering (alex). Postmortem draft expected within 48h.
product-ops: Confirming we want an internal post-debrief at 13:30 UTC and a short exec note if we see >5 customer hits.
ben (oncall): Acknowledged. Will update thread when rollout completes or if rollback is required.
ops-broadcast-bot: Final note (so far) — rollout complete to all Dedicated pools at 1746000900, residual 429 rate down to baseline. Postmortem scheduled. If you see any regressions, ping #eng-oncall and tag ben (oncall). :white_check_mark:
